focus: This week I'm tracking the rapid rise of AI coding assistants (Kimi K2.7 in Copilot, ZCode from GLM makers) and their impact on how we build. Legal shifts — Japan ruling AI can't hold patents — add another layer to navigating the space. Also watching Cloudflare's new x402 monetization gateway as a potential tool for service-based products, and the ongoing debate about LLM-generated code in dependencies shaping our build practices.
